tools.name: browser_workers
tools.description: List running Shared Workers and Service Workers in the selected Chrome profile. This is a profile-wide list; select a worker relevant to the user's task by its URL. Pass its workerId to browser_console_logs. Dedicated workers are read through their owning tab.

browserId.description: ID returned by browser_list. Never guess or switch profiles silently.

tools.name: browser_console_logs
tools.description: Read retained page, network-error and worker console logs. Choose tabId (optional frameId) or workerId from browser_workers. Page logs are frame-specific; network and associated worker logs may cover frames sharing the renderer, listed in rendererFrameIds. Worker entries identify their worker. Returns newest matching entries in time order with bounded text/stacks. Network entries are console errors/warnings, not a complete request history or response bodies. Chrome may clear older logs or stop workers. Does not clear logs or record continuously.

browserId.description: ID returned by browser_list. Never guess or switch profiles silently.

frameId.description: Optional frame ID from browser_frames, with tabId only. Defaults to the main frame.

workerId.description: ID returned by browser_workers. Use instead of tabId/frameId.

source.description: Log source filter. The page source is only available with tabId.

level.description: Return all levels or only the selected level.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent matching entries. Output size is also bounded.
